title: o-mcp/values version 1
description: One quantity for one or more nodes over whole site-time days, from the network model, which resolves every node whether metered or not. Returned by node_value. Each value carries its origin. Unknown fields may appear in later version-1 documents; ignore them.

schema.description: Names the format. Check it, and version, before reading anything else.

version.description: Format version. Adding fields keeps it at 1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field makes 2.

nodes.description: Codes of the nodes the server resolved the request to.

as_of.description: The window's last day. Nodes were looked up on the network of the window's days, latest first. Since 2026-10-22 the server picks it; values are solved on it unless pieces says otherwise.

window.description: Whole site-time days, start included, end excluded.

pieces.description: Added 2026-10-22, within version 1. The parts the window was solved in, each on the network of its own last day. One piece, the whole window, unless the plant changed inside it (finding PLANT_CHANGED); the values combine the pieces.

as_of.description: The network this piece was solved on: its last day.

quantity.description: The quantity and where the network model read it from.

utility.description: The utility network it was solved over.

unit.description: Unit of every value; null when dimensionless.

kind.description: RULE: solved by its own rule. DERIVED: computed from two solved quantities (in parts).

source.description: The table or view the meters' totals came from.

read_as.description: The buckets the window was cut on: site-time days or 15-minute buckets.

data_until.description: Where the source's data ends, site time; null if it has none. Earlier than the window's end means the values are short.

values.description: One per node asked for, in the order asked.

value.description: The value over the window: a total for energy and volume, the period's power factor for PF_TRUE, the 95th percentile for THD_VOLTAGE_LN. Null means no value, never zero.

origin.description: MEASURED: a meter on the node. ROLLUP: worked out from neighbouring meters by flow balance. INHERITED: taken from the feeder. DERIVED: computed from parts. NONE: no value.

parts.description: For a DERIVED quantity, the two solved inputs by quantity code (for PF_TRUE, kWh and kVArh); null otherwise.

findings.description: What the server noticed. Show message as is.

code.description: NO_VALUE: nothing measured or inferable for a node. NOT_IN_NETWORK: the node has no edge of this quantity's utility. DATA_INCOMPLETE: the source's data ends before the window does. PLANT_CHANGED (added 2026-10-22): the plant changed inside the window; the message says whether the window was solved in pieces or, for a quantity whose pieces can't be combined, on the network of its last day.

node.description: Code of the node, when the finding is about one.
